name: Neymarc Brothers
bio: Born in the US and raised in Paris, France, the Neymarc Brothers are film writers and directors celebrated for their dynamic and cinematic visual storytelling. Their first TV commercial aired during the Super Bowl (featuring John Stamos), which garnered over 100 million views. Their first short film, "Happy Valentine's Day" won Two Webby Awards, received a Vimeo Staff Pick and was shortlisted for a Cannes Lion in Film Craft. They've since directed multiple award-winning TV commercials, brand films, and are the filmmakers behind the immersive theatrical experiences at Summit One Vanderbilt in NYC and View Boston Observatory in Boston. They are currently in production of their short 'Dreamscape' as Lower Manhattan's Filmmakers-In-Chief and are in development on their first two feature films 'Timeless' and 'Memo Inc!’
